bullets.title: Tim Cook Steps Down as Apple CEO
bullets.body: Multiple sources confirm today marks Tim Cook's last day as Apple CEO. Cook took Apple from ~$350B to over $4T in market cap during his tenure. No successor details in the tweets, but the transition is underway.

bullets.title: Meta on Track to Overtake Google Search in Ad Revenue by End-2026 — Bernstein
bullets.body: Bernstein forecasts Meta will surpass Google Search in ad revenue by end of 2026, with Meta capturing nearly half of every incremental digital ad dollar in Q2. AI is cited as the key accelerant for Meta's ad growth.

bullets.title: Samsung Locks ~70% of Memory Capacity Through 2031 via LTAs with NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL
bullets.body: Samsung Memory has allocated approximately 70% of production capacity through 2031 via long-term agreements, with NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Google as primary counterparties — providing five years of demand visibility. Samsung DS is also considering converting its Pyeongtaek S5 foundry line into memory capacity as early as next year, while SK Hynix explores joint fab and expansion in Yongin and Honam.

bullets.title: Micron & SK Hynix Face Massive N3 Capacity Crunch for 2027 HBM Builds
bullets.body: Analysis shows Micron and SK Hynix collectively need 112M base dies in 2027 to produce 4EB of HBM (70% 8Hi, 30% 12Hi), requiring ~20k WPM of N3 — nearly 10% of all projected 2027 N3 capacity. The author argues diversification to Intel for base die production makes strategic sense given those constraints.

bullets.title: MRVL's Celestial Acquisition: Hidden $6–10B Value, $1B Revenue by 2029
bullets.body: One analyst argues that Celestial (acquired by Marvell) is on an annualized run-rate of $500M as of Q4, with a $1B revenue projection for 2029. If public, the estimated standalone valuation would be $6–10B — suggesting significant embedded upside not yet recognized in MRVL's stock price.

bullets.title: NVDA's Hugging Face Deal Seen as Platform Strategy Beyond Chips
bullets.body: Commentary highlights that Nvidia's partnership with Hugging Face is bigger than it appears, positioning NVDA as an AI platform player rather than a pure chip supplier and potentially unlocking new software-driven revenue streams.

bullets.title: AI Compute Demand Reaching Consumer Devices — Apple Macs, NVDA RTX Spark
bullets.body: AI labs and enterprises are reportedly acquiring any reasonably capable compute hardware, including Apple Mac mini/Studio and upcoming NVIDIA RTX Spark-based PCs, for inference and training workloads. OpenAI's large-scale Mac purchases are cited as evidence of infrastructure diversification away from exclusive cloud GPU reliance.

bullets.title: BYD's Operating Margin Widens Over Tesla: 5.4% vs. 1.4% in Q2
bullets.body: BYD posted a Q2 2026 operating margin of 5.4% versus Tesla's 1.4%, with BYD's H1 margin at 4.2% — up 1.9pp year-over-year. The comparison excludes government subsidies beyond industry-standard support that both companies receive.

bullets.title: EU DSA Designations Hit Reddit and Roblox as Very Large Online Platforms
bullets.body: The European Commission has designated Reddit and Roblox as 'Very Large Online Platforms' under the Digital Services Act, and ChatGPT as a 'Very Large Online Search Engine.' All three must comply with stricter content moderation and anti-misuse obligations under the new rules.

bullets.title: AMD and Cisco Expand AI Infrastructure in Saudi Arabia via Humain
bullets.body: AMD, Cisco, and Humain are jointly expanding AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, representing a growing Middle East regional tech buildout opportunity.

bullets.title: Oil Tops $91, Diesel Crack Near $100 on US-Iran Escalation; Supertanker Mined in Hormuz
bullets.body: Brent crude surged over $3 to $91.38/barrel as US-Iran strikes resumed and a supertanker was mined in the Strait of Hormuz. US diesel crack spreads approached $100, raising stagflationary risk. BofA separately warns that surging energy and agricultural commodity costs are squeezing consumer staples margins with limited pricing power to offset.

bullets.title: Warsh Hawkish at Jackson Hole; September Hike Odds Rise to 62%
bullets.body: Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech pushed September rate hike odds to 62%, though at least one observer is skeptical the Fed moves given slowing jobs and stable inflation. Bond market volatility remains in a bearish trend post-Jackson Hole per Hedgeye, and the Fed is now seen projecting higher inflation ahead.

bullets.title: European Sovereign Yields Surge to Multi-Decade Highs
bullets.body: Germany's 30-year Bund yield hit a 15-year high at 3.79% (+3bps) and France's 30-year yield reached 4.93% (+4.5bps), its highest since September 2008 — a notable tightening of financial conditions in the eurozone even as US Treasury yields ease.

bullets.title: TSM Sees Silicon Photonics Going Mainstream by 2027; Soitec Demand Surging
bullets.body: Commentary on Soitec notes that TSMC forecasts silicon photonics going mainstream in 2027, with Soitec expecting 80% of capacity reservation agreements signed within 1–2 weeks across 10+ partners, and $200M in photonics-SOI revenue described as 'absolutely a floor.'

bullets.title: Mag 7 Premarket: NVDA Only Gainer; MSFT and TSLA Down Most
bullets.body: Mag 7 stocks are mostly lower premarket with NVDA the sole outperformer (+0.6% after Friday's slide). MSFT and TSLA are each down 0.6%, GOOGL -0.5%, AMZN -0.4%, AAPL -0.3%, META -0.1%. S&P 500 e-mini futures down 0.26%, Nasdaq 100 -0.21%.

bullets.title: China's Record Naval Swarm Around Taiwan Raises Decoupling Alarm for Wall Street
bullets.body: China deployed a record number of ships around Taiwan, with the event described as sending a 'decoupling alarm to Wall Street' — raising geopolitical risk premium for tech supply chains dependent on the strait.

bullets.title: GOOGL Changes View-Counting to 1-Second Threshold — Metric Inflation Concern
bullets.body: Google reportedly changed YouTube's view-counting methodology to register a view after just 1 second, raising concerns about inflated metrics. One observer notes that TikTok and Instagram already count views from the very start of playback, potentially leveling the competitive comparison.
